facts.text: Through the Iowa Tuition Pledge, University of Dubuque promises to cover 100% of tuition for every qualifying high-achieving student from Iowa with demonstrated financial need.

sources.title: Financial Aid | University of Dubuque
sources.quote: Iowa Tuition Pledge is our clear and transparent promise to every qualifying student from Iowa. For every high-achieving eligible student from Iowa with demonstrated financial need, we will ensure that 100% of tuition is covered.
